title: Partner developer portal, service credentials and API products
workflow: Perform partner legal/KYB, security and commercial due diligence
Register appropriate API product and versioned OpenAPI contract
Issue environment-separated credentials via approved IAM
Enforce per-entity, scope, object, consent and purpose validation
Monitor rate limits, credential usage and failure/replay anomalies
Promote to production only after authorized contract and executed conformance
invariants: OAuth scopes do not override customer consent or legal bank entitlement
Sandbox credentials must not access production rail or real customer data
No embedded partner secret in client/mobile SDK
APIs must reject IDOR and tenant-confused requests at backend
Production access requires evidence of independent bank approval
Partner API cannot bypass core ledger commands
acceptance_tests: Partner cannot retrieve another bank's data
Rate limit blocks excessive calls without losing accepted commands
independent_gate: Bank's partner programme and lawful API data sharing rules, signed agreement, security tests and institution production approval.
